Name: Cometkins' Style Artisan Goods recolor masks 1.6 patch
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#fce5cd][i]A simple 1.6 fix for Cometkins'  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod[/url] for Wine, Juice, Jelly and Pickles.
[u]Big thanks to [b]QcMitsou[/b] who commissioned me to make this fix!﻿[/u][/i][/color]
[/size][/center][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]Since 1.6 has integrated artisan goods recoloring, original  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod[/url] got a bit outdated (since in 1.6 some artisan goods textures got relocated to new "Objects_2" tilesheets).  
This mod is aimed to be unofficial 1.6 update and meant to be used if you prefer to have automatic vanilla recoloring instead of downloading a ton of EBAGI mods. 
[/size][/center][size=3]

[/size][center][size=3]This mod include original  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod[/url]  textures for [b]Wine, Juice, Jelly and Pickles [/b]plus [b]recolor masks[/b] for them. I've also sligthly edited Pickles jar cap color (in original mod Jelly and Pickles cap textures were quite identical, so now it will be slightly easier to define one from another). 
[b]You also can disable any retexture in mod's config.[/b][/size][/center]
